sourceDescription: User-provided files from a Unity offline ARK Starmap remake. The source README describes the remake; no LICENSE file was found in the provided project. Individual recording authorship and redistribution rights are not established.
metadataPolicy: Canonical WAVs remove descriptive/BWF tags while retaining identical decoded PCM. MP3 derivatives remove ID3, Xing and encoder tags; normal codec frame padding is included in measured duration. Technical metadata removal does not change authorship or licensing.
defaultPreload: none; only application-owned active aliases are loaded by enabled effects
